_about: App 2's demo script for the cloned voice. Each line is [id, what the voice says, caption text if it differs]. Numbers are written as spoken. 'Sohan' is respelled by Fusion Voice Studio's pronunciations.json, never here.

lines: s01a
Hi, I'm Sohan. This is the same inspection app, rebuilt with two React code components inside Canvas.
s01b
It takes the places where Canvas stopped, and shows what it costs to cross that line.
s02a
The Canvas build hit real limits. The checklist stopped at level five, and a safety question never appeared.
s02b
Rules were hard-coded, and photo markup was freehand only, saved apart from the photo.
s03a
The screens around the components are still standard Canvas, on the same Dataverse tables.
s04a
An inspection starts the same way, with a site and a piece of equipment.
s05a
Now the checklist is one code component, written in React and TypeScript.
s05b
This forklift is out of service, with damage in the hydraulics, and fluid is leaking.
s05c
No spill kit has been deployed. A compound rule adds fifteen points, and it's a row in Dataverse, not a formula.
s05d
And here's the sixth level, the question Canvas could never show.
s05e
It's a critical stop, and the score reaches the cap of one hundred.
s06a
Code components in canvas apps cannot call Dataverse, so the app passes the data in as JSON.
s06b
The component hands the answers, the score and the explanation back through output properties.
s07a
The second component is the photo annotator, with numbered markers, arrows, boxes and freehand.
s07b
Every mark saves as data, and burned into a copy of the photo, so the original stays clean.
s08a
Review reads the component's outputs, and Submit saves everything to Dataverse.
s08b
The new inspection goes straight to the top of the list.
s09a
Under the hood, that's two React components and seven Dataverse tables.
s09b
Twenty-three Playwright tests drive the published app, and fifteen unit tests cover the components' logic.
s09c
All of this is sample data, in a developer environment.
s10a
Canvas still does most of this app. The code components took only the parts it couldn't.
s10b
The full build, the tests and the scripts are on my GitHub, and there's more on my portfolio. Thanks for watching.
